issue.description:
## Scope
Set up the test infrastructure for attempt-resolution conformance testing.

## Tasks
- Create test fixtures directory structure under tests/
- Generate old-format checkpoint fixtures (pre-attempt-resolution)
- Generate new-format checkpoint fixtures (with attempt-resolution)
- Create test harness that can load and validate fixtures
- Add helper functions for binary version detection and capability probing

## Acceptance
- tests/fixtures/attempts/ exists with old/ and new/ subdirectories
- Old fixture represents checkpoint before attempt-resolution feature
- New fixture represents checkpoint with attempt-resolution enabled
- Test harness can load both fixture types and validate schema
- Helper functions detect whether binary supports attempt-resolution
- cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings pass
- Unit tests for fixture loading and validation pass
issue.title: Create attempt-resolution test fixtures and harness

issue.description:
Artifacts: service transaction integrating attempt receipt, attempt tier/failure epoch, legal lifecycle action, resource-lock release, audit/change feed, and resulting revision/state.

Acceptance:
- Concurrent identical calls produce one semantic mutation and return one receipt.
- Same attempt ID with different payload conflicts.
- Stale revision/fencing and invalid outcome/action pairs change nothing.
- Work failure penalizes exactly once; infrastructure/cancellation does not.
- Crash-boundary, replay-after-unknown-response, transaction rollback, concurrency, and checkpoint-publication tests pass.
issue.title: Implement atomic idempotent attempt resolution service

issue.description:
Build the release-gate matrix after implementation.

Acceptance:
- Pinned pre-feature and feature-enabled bead-rs binaries exercise capability absence/presence and NEEDLE fallback/atomic paths.
- Tests cover concurrent replay, stale fencing/revision, each outcome/action, checkpoint suppression/failure/recovery, sharded and monolithic restore, and old/new checkpoint fixtures.
- cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test, cargo package, and installed-binary smoke tests pass against one exact commit.
- Evidence report records exact commands and hashes.
issue.title: Run attempt-resolution compatibility, concurrency, and recovery conformance
